title: "Manage workflow tasks"
date: last-modified
---

View and interact with outstanding workflow transition tasks assigned to your user roles for all workflows.

:::{.callout}
Tasks will only appear in your inbox if the workflow step[^1] is set up to display the action button to your user role[^2] or inventory record stakeholder type.[^3]
:::

::: {.attn}

## Prerequisites

- [x] {{< var link.login >}}
- [x] There are records registered in the inventory.[^4]
- [x] Record stages have already been customized for use in workflows.[^5]
- [x] Workflows have already been set up for use with your records or artifacts.[^6]
- [x] You are a assigned role with sufficient permissions to transition workflows into their next states.[^7]

:::

## View workflow tasks

1. In the left sidebar, click **{{< fa inbox >}} My Inbox**.

2. Select the **Tasks** tab.

3. From the in-{{< var vm.platform >}} task list, view your incomplete tasks, access records or artifacts attached to tasks, and transition workflows into their next states:

::: {.panel-tabset}

### View tasks

Tasks are listed with the following information:

- The name of the record or artifact the workflow is attached to
- The current workflow state of the workflow[^8]
- The name of the workflow attached to the record or artifact[^9]
- The due date of the workflow, calculated from the workflow's expected duration
- Action items associated with that task

To show older tasks, scroll down to the bottom and click **Load More**.

### Access details

To view the details of a record or artifact attached to a workflow task, click the button displaying the name of the record or artifact.

### Transition workflows

If an action is available to your role,[^10] you'll see it appear as an action button under a workflow task:

- Click **{{< fa arrow-right >}}** to open up the transition panel for your selected action. This arrow will be followed by the action name.
- Enter your **Notes** and any other additional inventory fields[^11] then click **Submit**.

Once completed, tasks will be removed from your view.

:::

## Resolve stalled approvals

An approval stalls when no one can vote on it. For example, the last eligible voter lost access to the record, or no one in the step's Approval Group qualified when the workflow reached it.[^12] When this happens, anyone who now qualifies is added as a voter and gets an approval task. If no one qualifies, the approval stays pending and a notice appears under Tasks in My Inbox for:

- Users with an admin role, such as [{{< fa hand >}} Customer Admin]{.bubble}
- The record's Model Owner. For an artifact workflow, this is the Model Owner of the record the artifact belongs to.

The notice shows the approval title, the record or artifact name, the workflow name and when the approval stalled. The approval is never approved or rejected on its own.

To resolve a stalled approval:

1. In the left sidebar, click **{{< fa inbox >}} My Inbox**.

2. Select the **Tasks** tab.

3. Click the title of the notice to open the record or artifact.

4. Do one of the following:

    - Give a user the role or record access the approval asks for.[^13] They are added as a voter and get an approval task.
    - Move the workflow on from the approval step.[^14]

The notice closes by itself once someone can vote or the workflow leaves the approval step. To remove it from your list sooner, click **{{< fa check >}} Mark as Done**. This doesn't change the approval or remove the notice for other recipients.
